name: ai.januaport/docs
title: JanuaPort Docs
description: Read-only JanuaPort setup guides for your AI assistant: install, set up, connect. No login.

tools.name: docs_get
tools.description: Reads ONE section of a setup guide. Without `abschnitt` you get the table of contents of the document (with the size of each section) — that is the normal first call; with `abschnitt` you get that section's text (a section brings its subsections with it). A whole long document is never returned in one answer. Every answer names the JanuaPort release the guide belongs to. Reads only; changes nothing.

id.description: Document key, e.g. "inbetriebnahme". Use docs_list if you do not know it.

abschnitt.description: Optional section heading. Omit it to get the table of contents first — that is the normal first step.

tools.name: docs_list
tools.description: Lists the setup guides this server can show: document key, title and a one-line summary for each. Call this first, then fetch a document with docs_get. To set JanuaPort up, first ask whether it already runs as a container: if not, start with `installation` (on Mac or Windows, tell the user first that Docker Desktop is for trying it out and a Linux server is recommended for operation); if it does, start with `inbetriebnahme`. Every answer names the JanuaPort release the guides belong to. Reads only; changes nothing.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Searches the setup guides for a question or a few words (not a single keyword). Returns document key, section heading and a short excerpt per match, best first — fetch the actual text with docs_get. Every answer names the JanuaPort release the guides belong to. Reads only; changes nothing.

frage.description: What you want to find — a question or a few words, not a single keyword. Word-level match: a hit needs at least one matching word; ranked by how many words matched.
